title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 (Xbox 360, 2011) MW3 CIB Activision Sledgehammer
descriptionText:
See pics.

Immerse yourself in the adrenaline-fueled world of modern warfare with Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 for the Microsoft Xbox 360. Experience the heart-pumping action as you take on the role of a member of an elite group of soldiers in this first-person shooter game. Choose from a variety of weapons and engage in intense combat to complete missions and conquer your enemies. 

With a mature rating, this game is not for the faint of heart. It features an all-new single-player campaign that continues the story of Modern Warfare 2 and offers hours of thrilling gameplay. Additionally, you can play with a friend or the computer in the new Spec Ops survival mode or earn all-new rewards by earning experience in the multiplayer game. This game is published by Activision and is part of the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Series and the Call of Duty video game series. It is compatible with NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) region codes and was released in 2011.
